column3: What happens when a share hits its 15% daily limit
column5: NEPSE notice not found online; Sharesansar (20 Apr 2026), Merolagani (9 Apr 2026), Beema Post, eAarthik, The Himalayan Times (18 Apr 2026), ICT Frame; Chapter 14 listing data
column7: Settled on the weight of evidence: no source says a share stops trading for the day at 15%; Chapter 8 and the glossary say orders beyond the limit are rejected but trading can continue at the limit, and Chapter 14's listing data show shares changing hands while locked at the upper circuit. The Himalayan Times line (a share moving more than 15% is not available for trading) fits this reading. Market tiers confirmed by all sources: 15-minute pause at 5% in the first two hours, full day at 8%. Base price for the 15% not stated in any report; the book uses the previous close (Chapter 8)
